churches.overall_label: Mixed — Promising but Verify Gender Roles

score_notes.christology: Affirms Jesus as 'the Son of God and co-equal with the Father,' both human and divine, who 'arose from the dead after three days' and will return 'personally and visibly to earth.' Orthodox Christology.
score_notes.scripture: Strong position: 'The Bible in its entirety is God's Word to us' and 'the sufficient authority and supreme and final source of truth for Christian beliefs.' Functionally affirms inerrancy and sufficiency.
score_notes.gender: Senior Pastor Chris Johnson (male). However, the church has women in ministerial titles: Megan Langan serves as 'Minister for Single Adults; Pastoral Care & Women's Ministry' and Tera Kouba as 'Minister of International/Asian Ministries.' Women hold 'Minister' titles — this goes beyond support roles. Yellow: not egalitarian in senior pastoral role but allows women ministerial titles.
score_notes.leadership: Senior pastor model with Chris Johnson. Staff of approximately 44 across ministerial, administrative, business, and facilities departments. 12 ministerial staff. References a 'lead team.' No visible elder board structure on website.
score_notes.soteriology: Clear grace-alone position: 'Salvation is God's free gift out of His grace to us' and comes 'only by personally trusting in Jesus Christ as God's offer of forgiveness.' Sound soteriology.
score_notes.cultural: No explicit DEI/CRT language detected. Church emphasizes Bible study integration across all ministries (same passage studied in Sunday School, worship, and small groups called 'Circles of Six'). Historic downtown church. Needs in-person evaluation.
score_notes.preaching: Unique approach: the same Scripture passage is studied across Sunday classes, worship services, and small groups ('Circles of Six'). This suggests a Scripture-centered, potentially expository approach. Television broadcast on KSAT-12 suggests substantive content.
score_notes.mission: Mission statement: 'to follow our Lord Jesus Christ, and to lead all others to a joyful life with him.' Extensive ministry portfolio: men's, women's, kids, youth, Spanish, Asian/international, recreation. Great Commission-oriented.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Dedicated men's ministry with 'Fearlessly Following Jesus' programming. Green for intentional male discipleship.
score_notes.denominational: SBC-affiliated. Southern Baptist Convention provides doctrinal accountability. Green.
